description: Given a household net worth in USD and a country (and optionally the age of the household head), return the wealth percentile it falls in and the 'top X%'. Answers questions like 'what percentile is a $500k net worth in Germany', 'is $1M a lot in Japan' or 'is $200k good at 30 in the US'. Public aggregate data, no personal or account information.

age.description: Optional age of the household head: ranks the net worth among households of that age group in the country (needs a country).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, DE, JP) or 'WORLD'. Omit for the worldwide distribution.

net_worth_usd.description: Household net worth in US dollars.

name: net_worth_percentile
title: Net worth percentile
